items.comments:
The place is great. Brand new, lots of working space a nice kitchen and good people. Bikes are free to borrow, and helmets are provided.
As a hack space it's only starting, but it seems that i'll kick off soon.

The house is beautiful and very comfortable, I met great persons there even though summer was over. From the moment of my visit the house was still far from the concept of a "hackers house", there are no events and no special effort on achieving techie interaction. So in general I would try the other house next time, I was kinda disappointed on that perspective.
I was not the one who lived in the hacker house but my sister. It was a great learning experience for her and it was a stimulating environment.
A comfortable house with friendly and interesting hosts. Would stay again!
